brand.name: LumenDesk Labs
brand.positioning: A fictional learning workspace for tiny research teams
claim_restrictions: No performance claims without a public source

product.name: LumenDesk
product.description: LumenDesk is a fictional workspace that groups notes, questions, and source links around a research decision.
product.problem: Small teams lose the reasoning behind decisions across scattered documents.
product.how_it_works: A team creates a decision space, attaches sources, and writes a shared conclusion.
benefits: Keeps a fictional decision trail together
differentiators: Organises work around decisions rather than document folders

audience.primary: Research leads at small product teams
audience.desired_outcome: Understand why a research-backed decision was made

offer.value_proposition: Keep sources, questions, and conclusions together for each fictional decision.
offer.promise: Make a fictional decision trail easier to revisit.

evidence.claim: LumenDesk has decision spaces, source cards, and shared conclusions.
